subject: Conditional evidence lanes & signature sprint — MAP alignment
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@heliohealth.com>

Cc: Sue Chen <sue.chen@heliohealth.com>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo. Helio's team is ready to move from eval to procurement but we need a short mutual action plan so our procurement and legal teams can line up the MSA/DPA and order form. Key asks from our side:

- A one-page MAP with milestones (security review, legal redlines, finance PO)
- Target signature window and what blocks the orderform acceptance
- Clear evidence items for the DPA (SOC2 artifact, data flow diagram, retention rules)

Can you propose a timeline and call out any internal decision points on your side? We currently have a targeted business go-live week of 11/8, so the procurement team would like signature by 10/22 to preserve that runway.

I've attached our intake questionnaire (not full security) and looped in Sue (legal) and procurement.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Rivera
Director, Cloud Integrations
Helio Health

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sue Chen <sue.chen@heliohealth.com>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Helio_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the path into three parallel lanes: Eval -> Legal & Security -> Procurement / Order form. High level proposal:

1) Eval lane (parallel): final tech Q&A and one short compatibility run — 10/16–10/20
2) Legal lane (serial-critical): MSA redlines back to us by 10/19, DPA-specific clauses (retention, subprocessing) by 10/19
3) Procurement lane (parallel with legal): PO review and order form acceptance pending signed MSA; target to have orderform locked by 10/20 for signature window

Proposed signature window: 10/21–10/22. That preserves your 11/8 go-live assuming no new redlines. Key blockers we see:

- MSA commercial redlines that introduce non-standard liability or indemnity language (needs us + legal to resolve quickly)
- Outstanding SOC2 evidence or unresolved dataflow questions (security needs artifacts by 10/18 to sign off)
- Any new SSO/KMS requirements that would push a week+

Action items for this week:
- Helio legal to send consolidated redlines to k.iyer@redwood.com by 10/19
- Helio security to confirm SOC2 artifact location or snapshot by 10/18 (we can accept a secure drive link)
- Redwood to circulate a cleaned order form (orderform_proposal_v2.docx) and DocuSign envelope by 10/20

I put a draft Doc link in the MAP and attached the workbook. Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk lanes.

Cheers,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
attachments: Helio_MAP_v1.xlsx (stub), orderform_proposal_v2.docx (stub)

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Jonas — good structure. A couple of procurement ops notes to tighten sequencing:

- Finance at Helio expects the PO to reference the exact order form line items; we should send the final SKU/pricing sheet by 10/18 COB so procurement can begin internal approvals.
- If legal redlines extend past 10/19 we should auto-escalate to a 1:1 between Karthik and Sue for same-day resolution.
- We should set a hard freeze on scope changes on 10/19 to avoid scope creep that would invalidate the orderform.

Karthik — can you confirm whether Redwood needs to share a SOC2 report snapshot or if our SOC attestation + control summary suffices for Helio? If a full SOC2 is required we'll need to arrange secure transfer and coordinate dates.

I'll add a pricing workbook row and push to the MAP drive.

Thanks,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evidence windows for MSA/DPA/order form

Looping in final legal confirmation. We reviewed Helio's sample redlines and Redwood's commercial posture. Summary and commitments:

- Redwood can accept Helio's DPA clause edits with two clarifying edits (retention window phrasing and subprocessors list). We'll provide updated DPA text by EOD 10/19 as requested.
- MSA: we cannot accept expanded indemnity beyond standard enterprise terms; propose language in MSA_redlines_helio.pdf (attached) and will prioritize a Karthik/Sue call should Helio insist on material changes.
- SOC2: control summary + auditor attestation is acceptable for procurement to proceed; we'll provide secure snapshot link to Helio security by 10/18.
- DocuSign: Redwood legal will prep the envelope once DPA + MSA textual convergence is complete. Target doc send: 10/20.

Risk and contingency: if consolidated redlines arrive late (after 10/19) we push signature to 10/25 and recommend a phased go-live (limited telemetry features first) to preserve the 11/8 business target.

Next steps (actionable):
- Jonas: confirm final SKU/pricing insertion into MAP by 10/18 (Laura owns)
- Helio legal: send single redline file to karthik_iyer@redwood.com by 10/19
- Redwood security: share SOC snapshot link to Sue by 10/18
- Redwood legal: post updated MSA/DPA PDF to drive and circulate by 10/19 EOD

Thanks — happy to take the call with Sue if needed.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
